words.gloss: He who is inside the eyes

literal: Since the beloved is inside the eyes, even the eyes we will not paint, knowing that he would be hidden.
translation: Since my beloved resides within my eyes, I will not even paint them with kohl, knowing that doing so would hide him from my view.
modern: என் காதலர் என் கண்ணுக்குள்ளே இருப்பதால், மை எழுதும்போது கண் மூடுவதால் அவர் மறைந்துவிடுவார் என்பதை அறிந்து, நான் என் கண்களுக்கு மை கூட எழுத மாட்டேன்.
explanation: In this verse, the heroine expresses her intense and constant love. She says her lover resides permanently inside her eyes. Therefore, she refuses to apply kohl (eye-paint) to her eyes, knowing that the act of applying it would require closing her eyes, which would temporarily hide him from her inner sight. This poetic exaggeration highlights how she cannot bear to lose sight of her beloved even for a single moment.
